faqs.question: What are Nafl prayers?
faqs.answer: Nafl prayers are voluntary prayers offered beyond the required daily prayers. They are a way to add worship, seek reward, and draw closer to Allah.

faqs.question: Are Nafl prayers obligatory?
faqs.answer: No. Nafl prayers are voluntary. The five daily prayers remain the priority, and Nafl prayers are added after a person protects the obligations.

faqs.question: Can Nafl prayers be prayed anytime?
faqs.answer: Many Nafl prayers can be prayed broadly, but there are times when voluntary prayer is avoided according to Islamic law. Follow your madhhab or local scholar for details.

faqs.question: How do you pray a general Nafl prayer?
faqs.answer: A simple general Nafl prayer is commonly offered as two rak'ahs using the familiar salah sequence. Named voluntary prayers can have their own timing or details, so follow your madhhab or a trusted teacher.

hero.introductionHtml: Nafl prayers are voluntary prayers beyond the required salah, giving Muslims more ways to worship, remember Allah, and build a steady prayer life.
hero.summaryHtml:
• Meaning: voluntary prayers beyond the required daily salah.
  • Priority: protect the obligatory prayers first.
  • Examples: Duha, Tahajjud, mosque greeting, and prayer after wudu.
  • Note: avoid restricted times and follow local scholarly guidance.
